description: NAR: Nirous Android Reversing. Reverse engineer any Android APK or AAB, apps and games, old and new, with CLI tools: triage, manifest and resources, DEX/smali, jadx decompile, native/JNI, game engines, Unity IL2CPP deep analysis, Flutter/Dart, app bundles, network traffic, Frida scripts, signatures, version compare, and feature maps.
